none: PAS CAM-F8EB31: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian I, AD 364-375
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS-REI PVBLICAE ; D/ DN V[ALENT]INI-ANVS P F AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian I, AD 364-375 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS-REI PVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Mint is Arles. Obverse legend reads DN V[ALENT]INI-ANVS P F AVG. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: -/-/[...]CON. Die axis is 6 o'clock.
